verdict.rationale: Recruitee hosts a live llms.txt (confirmed HTTP 200 by direct probe) that indexes documentation and supports appending .md to get markdown versions of pages, and this is corroborated by numerous individual .md-suffixed doc pages actually resolving. This directly matches the story of pointing an agent at llms.txt/agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no independent third-party confirmation of an agent actually consuming it successfully, and no OpenAPI/machine schema to complement the docs.
